messages:
jordan: Deploying new model pool to ap-south-1 and hit target registration failures during canary. Errors look like: "RegisterTargets failed: TooManyTargets" for several target groups. Seen across 2 AZs.

priya: Thanks for the heads up. Any chance the fleet autoscaler spiked a bunch of instances at once? Which target groups are affected?

jordan: Autoscaler did bring up ~120 instances in the cluster overnight to warm GPUs for a batch job. Affected TGs: rg-model-serving-pool-a, rg-model-serving-pool-b. Each TG shows ~500 registered targets before the errors.

infra-bot: [Alert] elbv2:RegisterTargets Throttle event detected in ap-south-1 for account ************. Peak error rate 18/min since 2026-03-18T02:10Z.

ben: Confirming, AWS doc says NLB/ALB target registration has soft limits per target group and also per account per-region target count. When you spin up thousands of short-lived ENIs it can hit VPCE/ENI quotas too.

carla: Do we have any recent quota requests for ap-south-1? I remember we bumped ENI quotas for the GPU fleet in us-west-2 but not in ap-south.

jordan: We haven't requested anything for ap-south-1. This fleet was recently expanded there for regional latency reasons. The autoscaler created many short-lived instances which explains simultaneous registers. Current impact: canary fails to reach healthy target threshold and we fallback to older model variant.

priya: Short-term mitigation: 1) Pause aggressive scale-ups for the canary pool; 2) Rollback to stable config or reduce canary instance count; 3) Open Service Quotas request for "Targets per Network Load Balancer" and "Targets per Region (account)" and also check "Interface VPC endpoints per region" and ENI increase.

ben: For the request, we should include a justification: production model-serving fleet needs predictable capacity for GRPC endpoints and we prefer to keep model shards pinned to instances (so fewer cross-AZ cold starts). Suggested quota numbers: increase targets per TG to 5k, account-level targets to 50k in ap-south-1, ENI quota to 20k. Also request a soft-rate increase for RegisterTargets API if possible.

jordan: Can someone open the AWS Support case? I'll paste the failing logs and the approximate growth curve. Also tagging @carla for a cost estimate — increasing quotas could lead to more capacity than we commonly use.

carla: I'll run a quick cost delta: if we scale to the upper bound our committed GPU spend would rise ~18% NRR but amortized model latency improvements are worth it. I'll share numbers in a follow-up thread.

priya: Action items: 1) ben open Service Quotas + Support case for ap-south-1 with the numbers above and include example timestamps where RegisterTargets failed; 2) jordan throttle the autoscaler for canary jobs; 3) carla provide cost delta by EOD.

ben: Opening case now. Draft summary I will use: "Request increase of NLB/ALB target counts and ENI/VPCE quotas in ap-south-1 for model-serving fleet. Justification: steady production traffic + planned regional expansion; current target registration Throttle errors leading to degraded canary rollouts. Account ID provided in case. Requesting expedited review." Will paste case id here once created.

infra-bot: [SupportCase] AWS case created: 1234567890. ServiceQuotas requests submitted: Targets-per-TG -> 5000, AccountTargets(ap-south-1) -> 50000, ENI limit -> 20000.

jordan: Thanks. Temporary workaround is in place, I'll keep monitoring. If we see more throttles we'll shift canary to us-west-2.

carla: Added cost estimate to the ticket comments. Will sync with finance tomorrow for any cross-region commit needs.

priya: Great. Please update this thread with the AWS case progress. Also, when we get the quotas increased we should add a throttling backoff in the autoscaler to spread RegisterTargets calls over a longer window.

jordan: Agree — adding exponential backoff for registration in the next patch. Will also add metrics for RegisterTargets error rate to alert earlier. Thanks team :thumbsup:
